01 / ABOUT

About me

I am a data scientist interested in data science for urban computing and simulation.

I am currently with CVS Health. I explore how data, models, and computational experiments can help us understand complex urban systems and support better decisions.

My interests span the full arc from observing cities through data to testing possible futures through simulation.

02 / RESEARCH

Research interests

Three connected ways of reading the city.

01

Urban computing

Working with spatial, mobility, and infrastructure data to understand how cities move and change.

02

Simulation

Building computational environments for exploring interactions, scenarios, and system-level outcomes.

03

Data science

Turning complex data into models, evidence, and interpretable insights for real-world urban questions.
